summary: Smart Share Global Ltd (Energy Monster) filed a 6-K announcing completion of its going-private merger on April 30, 2026, under the merger agreement dated August 1, 2025. Per the deal, each ADS (representing 2 Class A shares) was cashed out for $1.25 (implied $0.625 per ordinary share), approved by shareholders at an EGM on December 31, 2025. The company became a wholly-owned subsidiary of MidCo; all ADSs were cancelled, with dissenting shares entitled to fair value under Cayman law. Excluded shares received no consideration. The transaction eliminates public float; no break fee or advisor disclosed. Watch for timely ADS depositary payments and any appraisal proceedings.
